name: actavoces
description: Local-first meeting recorder and transcript workspace.
author: galtozzy <galtozzy+git@gmail.com>

scripts.build:landing: pnpm type-check && vite build --mode landing && node -e "require('node:fs').renameSync('dist-landing/landing.html', 'dist-landing/index.html')"
scripts.lint:rust: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -Dwarnings && cargo check
scripts.lint:py: cd worker && uv run task ruff-lint && uv run task pyright-lint
scripts.lint:all: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py
scripts.format:rust: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty
scripts.format:py: cd worker && uv run task ruff
scripts.format:all: pnpm format && pnpm format:rust && pnpm format:py
scripts.test:py: cd worker && uv run task tests
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:py
scripts.ci: pnpm sync:py && pnpm ci-run && pnpm type-check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py && pnpm test:all
